_note: Source/permission manifest for the Carriagetown Detailing unofficial concept. These are photographs published on the business's own website. Photography ownership and model/property releases have NOT been established. Use is limited to this private, unpublished concept presentation. Written permission must be obtained from Carriagetown Detailing LLC before any official or public launch.

rights.holder: Presumed Carriagetown Detailing LLC or its photographer - not verified
rights.grantedUse: Private concept presentation to the business owner only
rights.blockedUse: Public hosting, marketing, paid launch, redistribution
rights.actionBeforeLaunch: Obtain written permission from Jeff Sass for each image, or replace with owner-supplied originals
rights.screenshotNote: Four photographs currently in the build were recovered from phone screenshots of the business website supplied by the studio. This does not change the rights position: they remain the business's (or its photographer's) images, used only in this private concept, and written permission is still required before any launch.
rights.studioPosition: The studio believes these images are free to use because they are publicly visible. Public visibility is not a licence: the photographs remain the business's (or its photographer's) property. This is low risk for the intended use - the page is being sold to the owner, whose own photographs they are - but it is NOT a basis for publishing the page for anyone else, or for using the photographs as studio portfolio work.

photos.notPlacedReason: Judged the weakest image in the set and left off the page. It is dimmer and flatter than the rest, has no single subject, and the floor clutter (a rag, a creeper, loose cables) reads as untidy on a page whose argument is "every detail, in focus". The workshop authenticity it would add is already carried by better photographs: the hero Tesla has the shop behind it, the sports car has the Carriagetown sign on the wall, and the SUV is in a bay. Available to place in the about section on request - it would need the two visible customer licence plates blurred first, as was done for the saloon.

logo.note: Native size 119x67 only. Never upscaled. Concept currently uses live typography for the wordmark; the logo file is optional and is only rendered at native size if present.

captionRule: Captions and placements are descriptive only. No image is claimed to show a ceramic coating, paint correction, or any specific service outcome, because the source does not establish which job produced which photograph. The services section carries a visible on-page line stating that the photographs are gallery images and are not presented as the result of a particular service.

stillMissing.note: Only cargo-area is still unavailable, and nothing references it. Every slot on the page carries a real photograph.

beforeAfterFinding.observed: The business gallery labels this photograph BEFORE. A separate uncaptioned slide shows the same red vehicle, same rear bench, same camera position, clean.
beforeAfterFinding.resolution: The studio confirmed the two photographs are the same vehicle. A labelled before/after pair is therefore built into the work section. The page claims only what the two photographs show - the same rear seating before and after interior detailing. It makes no claim about products, technique, duration or any other outcome.
beforeAfterFinding.assumption: Rests on the studio's confirmation that the clean photograph is the after state of this job rather than the same car on a later visit. Worth confirming with Jeff before launch, since it is the one causal claim on the page.
beforeAfterFinding.dirtyPhotosUsed: Only this one, and only as the labelled BEFORE half of the pair.

reviews.source: Google reviews as displayed by the widget on the business's own website.
reviews.note: Quotes are reproduced exactly as displayed, including original spelling and punctuation. Four of the five are excerpts truncated by the widget itself; the ellipsis is where the source cut off. Nothing was completed, paraphrased or invented. No reviewer avatars are used. The page states on-screen that these are excerpts and links to the full reviews on Google.
reviews.aggregate: 4.9 / 55 reviews, qualified on-page as shown on the existing site, checked Sep 2026.
reviews.beforeLaunch: Confirm with the owner that he is happy to have these reviewers quoted on his site.
